description: Accidentalidad por Carreteras is a dataset listed in analisis.datosabiertos.jcyl.es open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Junta de Castilla y León. Its keywords are transporte, redes de transporte, red viaria, red de carreteras. The portal shows 3,962 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-12-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-analisis-datosabiertos-jcyl-es-portal.
